aboutus.text1: Building Smarter Solutions for Construction Professionals
aboutus.text2: Hello and welcome! Our journey in the construction industry began in 2004, inspired by our founder, a third-generation construction professional. With a passion for excellence and innovation, the National Property Institute was established. Over the years, we’ve encountered the same challenges as many in our field—juggling the demands of on-site work with the complexities of office management. We needed a solution that could seamlessly bridge both worlds, and that’s how BuilderBUILDER PRO was born. BuilderBUILDER PRO is more than just construction management software; it’s a tool forged from our firsthand experiences. Designed to streamline project management and enhance collaboration, it empowers you to efficiently manage your projects, whether you're on-site or in the office. We’re proud to introduce BuilderBUILDER PRO and excited to help you build smarter, faster, and more efficiently. BuilderBUILDER PRO will make you good, better and best!

drawer1.title: How does the weather integration feature help in project management?
drawer1.desc: The integrated weather forecast feature provides real-time weather updates, enabling you to plan projects with confidence and adjust schedules for any conditions that might impact your workflow.

drawer2.title: Where can I find my payment history?
drawer2.desc: You can find your payment history in the 'Billing' or 'Payment History' section under the 'Account' or 'Settings' menu. This section will provide a detailed breakdown of your past payments and invoices.

drawer3.title: What financial metrics are available in the reports section?
drawer3.desc: The reports section includes various financial metrics such as project budgets, expenditure breakdowns, profit and loss statements, and ROI calculations. These metrics help you analyze the financial health of your projects and make informed decisions.

drawer4.title: Can I track the workdays spent on a project?
drawer4.desc: Yes, you can track workdays spent on a project using the 'Time Tracking' or 'Project Timeline' feature. This allows you to see the total days and hours logged by team members, helping you monitor productivity and manage project timelines effectively.

drawer5.title: How do I receive notifications for upcoming project deadlines?
drawer5.desc: To receive notifications for upcoming project deadlines, enable notifications in the 'Settings' section. You can customize notifications to be sent via email, in-app alerts, or push notifications to ensure you never miss an important deadline.

drawer6.title: How can I invite team members to join a project?
drawer6.desc: To invite team members to join a project, go to the 'Project Management' or 'Team' section, and click on 'Invite Members.' Enter their email addresses, assign roles, and send invitations. They will receive an email with instructions to join the project.
